reproduction.method: Rank-2 MAP logistic matrix factorization by alternating damped Newton steps
reproduction.description: Learn two-dimensional word loadings from synthetic binary document co-occurrences.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
120 documents and 18 synthetic words replace 5,000 sampled 20 Newsgroups documents with 100 words.
Joint MAP factorization substitutes for JJ/Böhning variational binary/categorical FA; it is not ML Gaussian FA or marginal-likelihood binary FA.
Rank is already two, so no high-dimensional delta-function embeddings, MDS, K=10/50 comparison, or runtime benchmark. Training reconstruction loss is labeled as such.
